page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Printed page number centred at the head. No running head. Gathering signature "H 3." and catchword "les-" at the foot.

main_text.p: Dividunt etiam literas in Quinque classes, Gutturales, Linguales, Palatinas, Dentales, et Labiales, ut alii Orientales. Hoi, Haut, & Hharm, aspirationes sunt & pronunciantur ut Heb. ה[?] & Arab. ح[?] Saut & Saat. eundem sonum habent. scil. f.
Alph & Aain, per A potius quam per Heb. ע[?] vel Arab. ع[?] proferantur.
Waw. ut v confonans, vel w.
Zadai, & Zzap. ut z, vel ut Hebr. ז[?].
Pa & Pfa vix in vfu funt, nisi in lingua vul-gari & nominibus peregrinis

Vocales literis affixae omnes longae funt, & cum latinis a. e. i o. u. in fono couveniunt, ex-cepto a. primae stantiae quod ut Hebr. -: pro-nunciatur citiffime, & (e) fextae claffis, quod fono medio quasi inter (e) & (o) raptiffime profertur instar Scheva, cujus regulas inter le-gendum servare videtur.
Juxta Potkenium sub Gutturalibus, post focium post longam vocalem, & ab initio per (o) breve effertur, at fecundam Reatinum, Caninium et alios per (e) breve, ut Scheva.
main_text.head: SECT. III.
main_text.p: Nullas accentuum notas habent, sed voca-

page.notes: Printed "(101)" at the head is the page number. Greek and Arabic letters in the Hebrew and Arabic letter references (Heb. ה, Arab. ح, Heb. ע, Arab. ع, Hebr. ז) are uncertain and marked [?]. "-:" after "Hebr." is a printed sign, kept as printed. "fcil." is printed "scil." with a long s, read here as scil. The catchword "les-" is the start of the next page. "Pfa" and "vfu" are as printed.
